description: footRoll 50 over a break of 30: the ball takes 30 and the toe tip 20. The toe tip turns the ankle first: +20 about (0, 0, 18), offset (8, -24) gives (15.726024, -19.816462), so z = -1.816462. Then the ball turns that +30 about (0, 0, 10), offset (15.726024, -11.816462): y' = 19.527368, z' = -2.370344, so z = 7.629656. The Limb is at IK, so its hand reaches the foot's ankle target: (4, 4, 0) + 0.1 * (P - (0, 8, -6)).
